page.overview:
What is Future?

Future (initially known as Unknown City) is a location explorable in the console version of Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 2: Battle Nexus. It is the tenth Episode in the game.

This area opens up right after the Turtles defeat the . A pathway in the Sewers leads to a new map simply known as ?. When the new map is entered, they will be within a dark, raining area that is known as "Unknown City" on the map. After clearing the Episode's first section, a Station will be available. The Station Warp lists this area as ??????????. Upon accessing the Episode's third section, Slashuur reveals that this land is the Turtle's Future, one potential future should things continue as they are. The Turtles defeat Slashuur once more and have a conversation with him, which helps him remember his missing memories. After clearing the third section of the Unknown City, the name "Future" is permanently shown in both the area map (replacing "Unknown City") and in the Station Warp (replacing ??????????).

Being a future New York, there are many resemblances that could give away an early hint to the location's identity. The map in general is a dark and ruined variation of the New York map. The Station Warp area is generally in the same position as the Turtle's home. The first area is a Subway tunnel while the second area is the streets with signs saying 8 Main Street and Down Town. The Clear Result screen is a ruined variation of New York's Clear Result screen.

Notably, the Future houses only enemies coming from the , which also marks the first appearance of the Foot Sumo Ninja, one of the strongest enemies in the game. It is hinted that the Foot were responsible for New York's destruction, though the exact nature of the Future's creation remains unclear, with Slashuur simply stating "A battle. Meaningless battles such as this have existed from the distant past and last far into the future".
